core_obligations: Record the easy parts: the equivalence of the first two conditions is the definition of a weakly associated point, and the implications from the local ring to the henselization and from there to the strict henselization follow from the behaviour of weakly associated primes under the flat localisation maps, which are the henselization and strict henselization (proof lines 397-409).

Reduce the remaining implication: to prove that the strict henselization condition implies the local ring condition one may assume S affine, and taking an element of the pulled back module whose annihilator has radical the maximal ideal, use the colimit description of the strict henselization to descend that element to some etale neighbourhood of the point (proof lines 410-420).

Conclude by faithful flatness and the etale up and down lemma: the local map from the etale neighbourhood to the strict henselization is faithfully flat hence universally injective, so the annihilator of the descended element is the inverse image of the annihilator of the element, hence has radical the maximal ideal of the neighbourhood; thus the image point is weakly associated for the pulled back module, and the etale up and down lemma transfers this back to the original point (proof lines 421-430).
proof_roadmap: Definition and flat pullback give the first three implications (proof lines 397-409).
Descend the witnessing element from the strict henselization to an etale neighbourhood (proof lines 410-420).
Use faithful flatness to read the annihilator downstairs and the etale up and down lemma to finish (proof lines 421-430).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that being a weakly associated point of a quasi-coherent module is equivalent to the maximal ideal being a weakly associated prime after pulling the stalk back to the henselization or to the strict henselization (statement lines 379-395, tag 0CTU). One direction is the definition and the flat pullback statement, but the converse needs real work: it descends a witnessing element from the strict henselization to some etale neighbourhood using the colimit description of the strict henselization, uses faithful flatness to identify the annihilator downstairs as an inverse image so that its radical is the maximal ideal, and then applies the up and down lemma for etale neighbourhoods. The descent of the witnessing element is the substance, so the claim is H2.
